newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Shipping - Grain/oilseed cargoes - Jan 13.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Shipping - Grain/oilseed cargoes - Jan 13.

text.p: The following is the berthing schedule for major dry bulk vessels unloading at Taiwan's main grain ports at Taichung and Kaohsiung, as detailed on Monday by Taiwanese surveyors:
The discharging cargoes are given in tonnes. Berthing dates are for arrival in port/expected completion of discharge.

Incoming Taiwan grain/oilseed shipments in tonnes with scheduled dates of arrival. K is Kaohsiung; T is Taichung.
Taiwan also has bulk offloading facilities at Keelung.
